epic.title: launcher-hygiene
epic.intent_and_why: Ship three independent false-signal fixes named by LAUNCH_ORDER launcher-hygiene, each with red-before/green-after evidence: isolate the DC3 environ test from ambient SPINE_* vars; make run_crew.py's spine_terminal resolve through the archive gate's relocation instead of reading a stale absence as failed; document the harness-auto-backgrounding hazard and poll-until idiom in crew-dispatch.md.

definition_of_done: tests/test_mcp_identity.py DC3InheritanceMechanismTests pass isolated from the calling shell's ambient SPINE_* vars
run_crew.py's spine_terminal resolves a genuinely terminal spine through the archive gate's relocation, with no rubber-stamp of a non-terminal spine
skills/commander/references/crew-dispatch.md documents the auto-backgrounding hazard and poll-until idiom
clean-env full suite passes at or above the stated baseline; map regenerated

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Red-before/green-after evidence per task; no mock of both close_work and spine_terminal together (compose the real relocation with the real read)
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Per-task pytest red/green plus a full clean-env suite run
good_enough.appetite: One bounded LAUNCH_ORDER, no crew dispatch

hard_constraints: Do not dispatch a crew this run
scripts/checklist_engine.py is not owned by this lane
docs/CHECKLIST_SCHEMA.md and skills/admiral/templates/LAUNCH_ORDER.template.md belong to sibling lane tc6-doctrine
Task 3b ships only with both a red and a control, never on documentation alone
fixed_decisions: tests/test_spine_lifecycle.py TestSpineTerminalThroughArchiveRelocation stays, composing real close_work with real spine_terminal
Task 2 derives work_id from the spine path and globs .agent-work/archive/*-<work_id>/<spine-basename>, matched only when the file exists there

current_wave.objective: Land the three false-signal fixes with proof, and settle whether Task 3b (Stop-hook mechanical check) ships or is declined
exit_criteria: 0 failed in the clean-env full suite
spine driven to terminal with lease released
